docs.title: Heru Rusfiandi
docs.text: A reasercher in plant Biotechnology who has experienced in various areas and techniques such as Plant Breeding, Plant Genetics and Cells, Plant Tissue Culture, as well as Laboratory managerial for more than 10 years. I am currently pusuing a PhD programme in Queen Mary University of London in Biological science focusing in chromosome studies.
